event_promote_top: Top Tier Promotion (Path of a Partner)
node_01_bg: Background: Broadcast studio office equipped with top-tier luxury amenities. A private bar and a sweeping view exude the dignity of an industry leader.
node_03_pl: When I started, I couldn't even imagine this... but we made it here.
node_04_bg: The office door opens, and Madam walks in wearing a noticeably more elegant wine-red dress.
node_05_ld: (Quietly clapping) At last... this day has come.
node_06_pl: (Turning around) Madam... did you come all the way here just for this?
node_07_ld: (Sitting in the chair) Of course. I wanted to congratulate you on your promotion to Top Tier in person.
node_08_ld: (Raising her wine glass) Back when we acquired this broadcasting station...
node_09_ld: Even I didn't think things would turn out like this.
node_10_pl: (Smiling slightly) Me neither. Honestly... at first, I thought we would go bankrupt.
node_11_ld: (Smiling) But you pulled it off, didn't you?
node_12_bg: Madam takes a thick paper envelope out of her coat and places it on the desk.
node_13_ld: (Handing over the envelope) There will be no more interference from me.
node_14_ld: This broadcasting station is completely yours now.
node_15_res: (Taking the envelope) ...Thank you. For trusting in me and letting me reach this position.
node_16_bg: Madam stands up from her seat and gently pats your shoulder.
node_17_ld: (Softly) From now on, you are the face of this station.
node_18_ld: You can dream even bigger. Global expansion, franchising, whatever you desire.
node_19_ld: You have more than enough capability to achieve it.
node_21_bg: Madam stops at the doorway before leaving and looks back.
node_23_ld: From now on, I won't call you 'CEO'... but 'Partner'.
node_24_ld: (Smiling) Looking forward to our future together, Partner.
node_25_pl: (Smiling) ...Yes. Let's make great things happen together.
node_26_bg: Madam leaves, and quiet returns to the office. The night view outside the window sparkles brightly.
node_28_pl: (Organizing papers) Alright. Now the real journey begins.
